description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the RecognizeImageStyle operation in the image recognition category
description_zh: 本文介绍图像识别（imagerecog）类目下的风格识别RecognizeImageStyle的语法及示例
name: RecognizeImageStyle

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS URLs in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: url

Data.description_en: The data returned in the response

items.description_en: The list of recognized styles. Valid styles include: chinese (Chinese style), watercolor, cartoon, real (realistic), standard, simple, lively, colourful, luxury, technology, morbidezza (soft), strong, simpleelegant (simple and elegant), coolcold (cool and cold), promotion, and protrude (prominent)
items.description_zh: 识别出的风格列表。风格包括：chinese（中国风）、watercolor（水彩）、cartoon（卡通）、real（实景）、standard（标准）、simple（简洁）、lively（活泼）、colourful（多彩）、luxury（豪华）、technology（科技）、morbidezza（柔美）、strong（硬朗）、simpleelegant（素雅）、coolcold（高冷）、promotion（促销）、protrude（突出）
